subject.title: fix: allow bailian provider in resolveThinkingProfile

question: Should OpenClaw accept automatic Qwen-thinking inference for custom `bailian` provider configs, or keep Bailian reasoning support only in provider-owned Qwen/Coding Plan surfaces?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes provider/model capability defaults for existing custom configs and overlaps a broader open Coding Plan product decision.

options.title: Accept Narrow Custom-Provider Slice After Cleanup
options.body: Remove the vLLM policy change, require proof for the changed no-explicit-reasoning path, and allow `bailian` Qwen compat inference as a deliberate supported behavior.

options.title: Defer To Qwen Provider-Owned Work
options.body: Pause this PR and continue the broader Coding Plan reasoning support through the canonical Qwen/provider issue and bundled provider fixes.

options.title: Require One Consolidated Fix
options.body: Ask for one PR that combines custom Bailian inference, bundled catalog capability, docs, and tests after vendor verification.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Custom-Provider Slice After Cleanup
recommendation.body: Remove the vLLM policy change, require proof for the changed no-explicit-reasoning path, and allow `bailian` Qwen compat inference as a deliberate supported behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged adjacent Qwen/vLLM thinking surfaces and is already tied to the support-boundary review on the canonical issue.
